notes.title: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH – Update 1.5.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello players!

After a period of continuous improvement, the English and Japanese versions of the game have been further optimized. Many thanks to everyone who provided feedback and helped us along the way!

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue with the photo unlock logic in Episode 2's album. The solo photo at the end of Ep2 should now unlock properly.

Optimizations

- Unified the modeling game of Sketching

- Removed event billboards

Bug Reporting
You can submit bug reports via the in-game settings menu (Bug Report button), or directly through the form at: https://jsj.top/f/QGZ9RU
You are also welcome to join our Discord.

notes.title: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH – Update 1.5.18 Patch Notes
notes.content:
BUG FIXES

- Fixed an issue where the Pi storyline could not be triggered when going out on Day 6.

OPTIMIZATIONS

- Improved certain text.
- Enhanced guidance on Day 5.
- Refined Japanese localization.
- Polished details in certain story.
- Corrected minor typos.
- Added a monologue review feature.

We are continuously improving the English and Japanese localizations. Since the game’s release, we’ve received a lot of valuable feedback from players, which has greatly helped us. Your insights have inspired us to refine many details and find better ways to tell the story. Thank you for your support, and please look forward to further improvements in localization quality.

BUG REPORT CHANNELS

You can submit bug reports via the bug report button in the game’s settings menu or directly through this survey link: https://jsj.top/f/QGZ9RU.
You're also welcome to join our Discord.

notes.title: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH – Version 1.5.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
BUG FIXES

- Fixed an issue where the date was missing in the save interface.
- Fixed a crash caused by accessing uninitialized settings data.
- Fixed a crash caused by accessing corrupted save files.
- Fixed an incorrect character in the Day 5 conversation between Norida and Viz.
- Fixed missing clues when viewing Will and Ben on Day 5.

OPTIMIZATIONS

- Improved the condition checks for Nor links on Day 9.
- Enhanced the Day 1 tutorial for accelerated actions.
- Refined the ending conversation with Lith on Day 6 to avoid repetition.
- Updated descriptions for Dom and the work group chat.

We’re continuously gathering feedback from players. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to submit a feedback form or join our official channels to connect with us.
Thank you for your support! We’ll keep working hard to make the game even better.

BUG REPORT CHANNELS

You can submit bug reports via the bug report button in the game’s settings menu or directly through this survey link: https://jsj.top/f/QGZ9RU.
You're also welcome to join our Discord.

notes.title: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH Version 1.5.6 Update Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

- Fixed issues with the character introductions in the 8Design work group.
- Fixed issues with the introduction for Sake.
- Fixed an issue where the scroll speed in the chat history window was too fast.

Optimizations

- Optimized the timing for unlocking the Fireworks Festival album and achievements.
- Increased the number of save slots to 20.
- Reduced the maximum key press per input from 5 to 4.
- Optimized Steam achievement unlocking logic.
- Optimized the countdown timer for message deletion gameplay on Day 5, increasing it from 500 seconds to 600 seconds.
- Optimized click prompts for voice messages on Day 5.
- Optimized Fireworks Festival date records by moving them to the overall save system.
- Optimized task prompts and trigger processes on Day 8.
- Fixed side effects that stop Miki from shopping on Day 8.
- Added a quick input feature and corresponding toggle for new game plus.
- Added a feature to quickly skip video calls and outdoor dialogues.

We are continuously gathering feedback from players. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to submit a feedback form or join our official channels to share your thoughts with us.
Thank you for your support! We will keep striving to improve your gaming experience.

Bug Reporting Channels
You can submit bug reports via the bug feedback button in the game settings menu or directly through this survey link: https://jsj.top/f/QGZ9RU.
We also welcome you to join our Discord.

notes.title: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH Version 1.5.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where Chinese words "今天又学习了计算机操作" was repeatedly displayed on the settlement screen.
- Fixed the text prompt issue after rejecting Meeka's payment.
- Fixed the repeated reminders to accept Meeka's payment after already accepting it.
- Fixed the issue where dialogue with Nora remained accessible after opposing her in "Day3".
- Fixed the blank dialogue issue in the shop.
- Addressed confusions caused by placeholder debug information.

Optimizations

- Optimized the dialogue logic for "Day3" when checking U-related conversations.
- Improved Holly's introduction.
- Enhanced the logic for date records in the ending.
- Refined certain outing conditions.
- Improved achievement unlock logic: the startup screen will now attempt to unlock achievements already recorded in the saved file.


We’ve noticed that some players are experiencing difficulties unlocking achievements and finding the experience of unlocking multiple endings across playthroughs less than ideal. We’re actively working on improving the interaction in these areas to make new game plus more flexible. Thank you for your support; we’ll continue striving to make the game even better!

Bug Report Channels

You can report bugs via the bug feedback button in the game settings menu or by filling out the survey at https://jsj.top/f/QGZ9RU.

You’re also welcome to join our Discord channel.
